title: 第11章 主线完成第12章 大丰收第二位气运之子
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
从正堂出来后，方玉凝便依靠着系统对林尘的定位，疾速追了过去。
自己的主线任务还没做完呢！
有疾风步的加持，方玉凝很快就追上了林尘。
准确的说，是林尘停了下来。
位置所在，正是林家后山。
“林尘这小子，果然喜欢在后山呢。”
小声嘀咕几句，方玉凝看着前方凝望天空的身影，悄然走了过去。
“怎么了？有心事啊...还是后悔了。”
带着调侃的语气，方玉凝十分自然的坐在了林尘的身旁。
顺手将一个白瓷瓶递了过去。
那是疗伤用的。
“玉凝姐啊，你来了。”
林尘转头，面色平静的说道。
“怎么？”
方玉凝一挑眉头，嗤笑道：“看你的样子，好像是知道我会来一样。”
“当然，你说的，无论我在哪，你都会找到我的。”
林尘语气平静的说着，倒是让方玉凝起了一身鸡皮疙瘩。
沃特？
她什么时候说过这样的话？
这死嘴，为了点情绪值，真是什么话都敢说啊！

“哈哈，有嘛？我可不记得。”
虽然心里一阵打鼓，但方玉凝还是扯出一抹笑来，玩笑似的回应。
“没关系，我记得就行，那天我从山崖上滚下来......”
随着林尘的话音落下，碎片样式的画面
开始不断在方玉凝的脑子里回放。
啊~嘶！
死去的回忆开始攻击她。
“好，打住，我记得了。”
揉捏着太阳穴，方玉凝抬手捂住了林尘的嘴巴。
再让他说下去，指不定把什么惊世骇俗的话给抖出来呢。
年纪轻轻的，怎么记性那么好？
“玉凝姐，你好香啊~”
仰着脖子躲开那只小手，林尘脸上露出笑意。
香风扑鼻，让他心情一时舒畅不少。
“你？讨打！”
方玉凝佯怒道，柳眉微蹙。
白玉般的脸上，升起薄薄的红晕。
虽然嘴上这么说着，但她心下已生退意。
准备提前结算主线任务，提取奖励。
content_en:
After coming out of the main hall, Fang Yuning relied on the system's positioning of Lin Chen and quickly chased after him.
I haven’t finished my main mission yet!
With the blessing of Wind Step, Fang Yuning quickly caught up with Lin Chen.
To be precise, Lin Chen stopped.
The location is right at the back of the Lin family.
"This kid Lin Chen really likes to be in the back mountain."
After muttering a few words in a low voice, Fang Yuning looked at the figure staring at the sky in front of her and walked over quietly.
"What's wrong? I'm worried...I still regret it."
With a teasing tone, Fang Yuning sat next to Lin Chen very naturally.
He handed over a white porcelain bottle.
That's for healing.
"Sister Yu Ning, you are here."
Lin Chen turned his head and said calmly.
"What?"
Fang Yuning raised her eyebrows and sneered: "Looking at you, it seems like you knew I would come."
"Of course, you said, no matter where I am, you will find me."
Lin Chen said in a calm tone, which actually made Fang Yu's skin crawl.
Walter?
When had she ever said such a thing?
Such a stubborn person, he would dare to say anything just to gain some emotional points!
"Haha, is there any? I don't remember."
Although her heart was pounding, Fang Yuning still smiled and responded like a joke.
"It doesn't matter, I just remember. I rolled down the cliff that day..."
As Lin Chen’s words fell, a fragmented picture appeared
It began to replay in Fang Yuning's mind.
Ah~hiss!
Memories of the dead began to attack her.
"Okay, stop it, I remember."
Kneading her temples, Fang Yuning raised her hand to cover Lin Chen's mouth.
If he keeps talking, he might say something shocking.
How come you have such a good memory at such a young age?
"Sister Yu Ning, you smell so good~"
Lifting his neck to avoid the little hand, Lin Chen had a smile on his face.
The fragrant breeze filled his nostrils, making him feel much better for a moment.
"You? Asking for a beating!"
Fang Yuning pretended to be angry and frowned slightly.
A thin blush appeared on her jade-like face.
Although she said this, she already wanted to quit.
Prepare to settle the main tasks in advance and withdraw rewards.
